name: Hoshi ni Negai o / Starlight Starbright Prequel
source: Infectious diseases and parasitic infections that change the mind and body of the infected person-commonly known as "parasites". Gears that go crazy after the demolition of the hospital where it was housed. The magician Amane Kikyo encounters a number of incidents when she meets puppeteer Kyoya Kurusu.
translation: 改变感染者思想和身体的传染病和寄生虫感染——俗称“寄生虫”。医院拆除后，齿轮疯狂运转。魔术师天音桔梗在遇见木偶师来栖恭也时遭遇了一系列的事件。
